quote: You don't have to control your thoughts. You just have to stop letting them control you.
Tips: Take a 5-minute walk,Write down one worry and one fact,Name 3 things you can see; 3 you can hear,Try box breathing for 4 cycles

quote: Anxiety does not empty tomorrow of its sorrows, but only empties today of its strength.
Tips: Sip warm tea slowly,Do a 1-minute body scan,Turn off notifications for an hour

quote: The greatest weapon against stress is our ability to choose one thought over another.
Tips: Stretch your shoulders,Write 2 lines of gratitude,Take a mindful shower,Plan one small treat

quote: Respira. Estás vivo y eso es un milagro.
Tips: Inhala por 4, exhala por 4; por 4 ciclos,Envía un mensaje amable a alguien,Escucha una canción completa sin distracciones

quote: You are more than the sum of your doubts.
Tips: Write one kind sentence to yourself,Do one task you've delayed,Stand tall for 30 seconds and smile

quote: Tu vaux plus que tes peurs.
